subject: Private/VPC pricing discovery - token volumes & licensing - LedgerWorks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@ledgerworks.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's Private/VPC discovery call

Hi Aisha / Tom,

Great speaking with you earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of needs we heard:
- Private/VPC deployment behind LedgerWorks' VPC (single-tenant)
- Multi-environment requirement: dev, staging, prod (we discussed isolated prod cluster)
- Throughput: bursts for batch processing and sustained low-latency inference for web/UX
- Compliance: SOC2 + audit logs + customer-managed KMS

Open qualification items for pricing: 
1) Estimated monthly token volumes (ballpark min / typical / peak) - helps us size reserved capacity.
2) Budget range or target unit economics (target $/1M tokens or equivalent cost expectation).
3) Preferred licensing model: annual committed capacity vs. flat platform + overage vs. usage-only.
4) Support tier: Standard vs. Premium vs. Enterprise (SLAs, 24/7 escalation).

What I'm sending you now: a short pricing matrix and SOW template (see attachments) that show our typical Dedicated/Private pricing buckets and what's included at each support tier.

Action items / next steps:
- Aisha: can you confirm token volume ranges and a ballpark budget target for us to build an initial committed proposal?
- Tom: any constraints on the number of environments / regions we should plan for?
- Ben: I'll draft two priced options - conservative committed capacity + enterprise support, and a lower-commitment option with predictable platform fee.

If it's useful I can also schedule a 30-min follow-up with our pricing/solutions lead to walk through the tradeoffs.

Thanks - talk soon.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachments: redwood_private_pricing_matrix.xlsx, ledgerworks_requirements.pdf

From: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@ledgerworks.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@ledgerworks.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's Private/VPC discovery call

Ben, thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Quick answers below to help you size the proposal: 

Token volumes (monthly, rough):
- Minimum (pilot / alpha): ~5M tokens/month
- Typical (first 6 months GA): 50M - 80M tokens/month
- Peak (end of year target): 150M - 200M tokens/month (batch jobs and some higher-traffic days)

Budget / unit economics:
- We'd like to target around $300 - $450 per 1M tokens for total infra+license cost as a starting point. That's a combined internal goal (hosted + infra) - we understand actual private licensing may differ.

Licensing preference and support:
- Preferred licensing model: annual committed capacity with monthly billing; we like predictable cost and overage bands.
- Support: leaning Enterprise for the SLA and 24/7 escalation during rollout. We will need onboarding and runbook support.

Environments / Regions:
- Environments: dev, staging, prod (so 3) - prod must be isolated and in us-west-2.
- Region: US (primary in us-west-2; staging/dev can live in us-east-1 if needed).

Other notes:
- Security team will request SOC2 evidence and a short network diagram. I can loop them in on the next thread once we have a pricing anchor.

If you can put together two price anchors: one that hits our $/1M target (with committed discounts) and one that shows a conservative committed cluster sizing, that should be helpful.

Appreciate it,
Aisha
Head of ML Infrastructure | LedgerWorks
aisha.gupta@ledgerworks.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@ledgerworks.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's Private/VPC discovery call

Thanks Aisha, this is exactly what we needed. A few clarifying notes and what we'll include in the formal quote: 

1) Licensing model options we'll propose (top-level):
- Option A (Committed Reserved): annual committed capacity (tokens/week equivalent + reserved GPU pools) with overage bands. Lower unit $/1M at scale. Includes security package and 24/7 Enterprise support.
- Option B (Platform + Overage): annual platform fee + metered usage; slightly higher marginal $/1M but less upfront commitment.
- Option C (Managed Hosted Hybrid): runway on Redwood Hosted while we migrate to Private; good for shorter pilot windows.

2) Price anchoring: based on the 50-200M range you provided, we can hit the ~$300-$450 per 1M target at the higher committed tiers. At pilot volumes (5-50M) unit costs will be higher unless we structure a minimum commitment. I'll include targeted $/1M tiers in the spreadsheet and call out breakpoints (e.g., 0-50M, 50-150M, 150M+).

3) Environments and infra footprint: we'll size for 3 environments (dev/staging/prod) with a single isolated prod cluster in us-west-2. If you expect cross-region failover we'll include costs for an additional passive cluster in us-east-1.

4) Support and onboarding: enterprise tier includes dedicated onboarding, runbooks, custom monitoring dashboards and 24/7 escalation. We'll itemize the hours for onboarding and training.

Next steps: I'm attaching the pricing matrix and a draft SOW to this thread. If it looks good, can we schedule a 30-minute call Friday to walk through the anchors? I'll also loop Marissa and Neha on the formal quote.

Best,
Ben

Attachments: redwood_private_pricing_matrix.xlsx, ledgerworks_requirements.pdf
